fullDescription: A calm, premium account form in graphite on off-white: floating-label hairline inputs that lift on focus, Inter type, one solid ink button, no boxes or shadows.

structured.summary: A calm, premium account-form landing in graphite (#1c1c1e) on warm paper (#fbfbfa), built around floating-label hairline inputs: the label rests inside each field and lifts + scales to 0.78 on focus or fill while a 1px graphite underline draws in from the left. Inter throughout, generous whitespace, one solid graphite button, no field boxes or drop shadows. A sticky blurred nav, a three-up pattern strip on a mist band, a live form-card preview, a full-bleed dark prompt section, and a palette specimen strip.

style.description: Restrained, editorial, premium-minimal. Monochrome graphite-on-paper palette with a single near-black accent; hairline borders (black at 5-10% opacity) instead of heavy boxes; Inter at 400-800 weights, tight negative tracking on headings; lots of breathing room; one solid ink button as the only filled surface in light sections; a single full-bleed dark (graphite) section for contrast.
style.prompt: Design in a restrained, premium-minimal editorial style. Palette: graphite ink #1c1c1e (primary text + buttons + dark section), ink2 #2c2c2e (code panel surface), platinum #c7c7cc (rest/muted on dark), mist #f4f4f5 (light band), paper #fbfbfa (page background); white #ffffff for cards; borders are black at 5-10% opacity (border-black/5, border-black/8, border-black/10). Typography: Inter (400,500,600,700,800) via Google Fonts, font-family Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; antialiased. Headings are heavy (font-700/800) with tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.03em) and leading ~1.04-1.08; eyebrows are 12px font-600 uppercase tracking 0.18em in muted ink2/70; body is 14-17px in ink2 at 65-80% opacity. No drop shadows on form fields; cards use a soft layered shadow (0 30px 60px -34px rgba(28,28,30,.22)). Subtle dot-grain texture at 2.5% opacity over the hero. Quiet, legible, never loud.

layout_and_structure.description: Single long-scroll desktop page at max-width 72rem (max-w-6xl), 6 stacked full-width sections: sticky nav, hero, full-bleed mist pattern strip, live-preview split (copy + form card), full-bleed dark prompt split, palette specimen strip, footer. Two-column sections collapse to single column on mobile.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-50), 64px tall, paper/80 background with a saturate+blur backdrop (backdrop-filter: saturate(180%) blur(12px)) and a bottom hairline (border-black/5). Inside a max-w-6xl row, justify-between: left = a 28px rounded-md ink tile with a white ph:rows-fill icon, the wordmark 'Graphite' (15px font-700, tight tracking) and a muted '/ Form Design' that hides on small screens; center = three nav links (Patterns, Preview, Prompt) at 13.5px font-500 muted, shown only on md+; right = a pill button 'Open in canvas' in solid ink with paper text and a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon that nudges right on hover.

Full-width hero on paper with a faint dot-grain overlay (2.5% opacity). Inside max-w-6xl, padding-top ~28 / bottom ~20 (md). A pill badge (white, border-black/10, rounded-full) with a tiny ink dot and 'Prompt library · Forms & inputs' in 12px muted. Then a huge headline (max-w-3xl, 2.6rem mobile up to 4.25rem md, font-800, leading 1.04, tracking -0.03em): 'The floating label, done with restraint.' with a line break before 'done'. A 17px muted sub-paragraph (max-w-xl). A button row: solid ink pill 'See it live' + ph:arrow-down-bold, and a white outlined pill 'Copy the prompt' + a muted ph:copy icon.

A full-bleed section with top+bottom hairlines on mist (#f4f4f5). Header row: eyebrow 'INSIDE THE PATTERN' over an h2 'Three details that earn it' (up to 2rem, font-700), with a muted '01 / 03' counter on the right (md only). Below, a three-column grid using a 1px gap over a black/8 background to draw hairline dividers (grid gap-px bg-black/8, rounded-2xl, overflow-hidden). Each cell is a paper card (p-7) with a 40px rounded-lg ink/5 icon tile (ph:arrow-line-up, ph:minus, ph:circle-half), a 1.05rem font-700 title (The lift / The hairline / The palette) and a 14px muted description.

A 12-column grid (lg) on paper, items-center, gap-12, py ~20-28. Left (col-span-5): eyebrow 'LIVE PREVIEW', h2 'Click a field. Watch the label lift.' (up to 2.6rem font-800), a muted paragraph, and a 3-item checklist where each row is a ph:check-circle-fill ink icon + 14px font-500 label. Right (col-span-7): the form card, centered, max-w-md.

A white card, rounded-2xl, border-black/8, padding 8-10, with a soft reveal shadow that deepens on hover. Header: a 24px rounded ink tile with ph:identification-card, an eyebrow 'CREATE ACCOUNT', an h3 'Start designing' (1.5rem font-800) and a 13.5px muted line 'It takes about thirty seconds.' Then a form with space-y-7 of floating-label fields (Full name, Email address, Password, and a 'What are you building?' textarea), ending in a full-width solid ink button 'Create account' + ph:arrow-right-bold (rounded-xl), and a centered 12.5px 'Already have one? Sign in' link.

A full-bleed graphite (#1c1c1e) section with paper text. 12-col grid (lg), items-center, gap-12, py ~20-24. Left (col-span-5): platinum eyebrow 'THE PROMPT', h2 'Reproduce it in one line.' (up to 2.5rem font-800), a platinum/80 paragraph, and three outlined chips (border-white/15, rounded-full): Floating label, Hairline fields, Graphite. Right (col-span-7): a code panel (rounded-2xl, bg ink2 #2c2c2e, border-white/10) with a title bar ('prompt.txt' + a Copy affordance with ph:copy) and a wrapped <pre> of the reproduction prompt where key phrases and hex codes are highlighted in paper white. Below: a paper pill button 'Open in canvas' + ph:arrow-up-right-bold and a muted 'Source pattern: floating-label input · CodePen' caption.

A paper section with a top hairline. 12-col grid (md): left (col-span-4) eyebrow 'SPECIMEN' + h3 'The graphite set'; right (col-span-8) a 2-up (sm: 4-up) grid of swatch cards, each rounded-xl border-black/8 p-3 with a 48px rounded-lg color block, a 12px font-600 name and an 11px hex: Graphite #1c1c1e, Ink 2 #2c2c2e, Platinum #c7c7cc, Paper #fbfbfa (paper swatch carries a faint repeating-line texture).

A slim footer on paper with a top hairline. max-w-6xl row, stacks on mobile and goes side-by-side on sm+: left = a 24px ink tile with ph:rows-fill + 'Graphite Form Design' (13px font-600); right = a 12.5px muted line 'A Superdesign prompt-library pattern · 2026'.

special_ui_components.prompt: A pure-CSS floating-label field with no box: a transparent input with only a 1px bottom border (#d8d8dc) and top padding 1.5rem so the label can sit inside. The label is absolutely positioned at top:1.45rem in muted #6a6a6e. On :focus or :not(:placeholder-shown), the label transforms translateY(-1.45rem) scale(0.78), turns graphite #1c1c1e, font-600, letter-spacing 0.02em; the placeholder is transparent so only the label communicates the field. A separate 1.5px graphite underline (.bar) sits at the bottom with transform: scaleX(0) origin left and transitions to scaleX(1) on focus (cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), ~0.42s), so the line draws in from the left. Same behavior for a resize-none textarea variant.

special_ui_components.component: Solid ink button with hover lift
special_ui_components.prompt: Primary button: solid graphite #1c1c1e, paper text, rounded-full (pills) or rounded-xl (form submit), 14-14.5px font-600. On hover it lifts translateY(-1px) and gains a soft graphite shadow (0 10px 28px -10px rgba(28,28,30,.45)); transitions ~0.25s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). Trailing iconify icon (ph:arrow-right-bold / arrow-up-right-bold / arrow-down-bold).

A three-up feature grid that renders dividers without explicit border lines: set the grid to gap-px on a black/8 background with rounded-2xl + overflow-hidden, then give each cell a paper background, so the 1px gaps read as crisp hairline separators.

A dark code card (bg ink2 #2c2c2e, border-white/10, rounded-2xl) with a title bar ('prompt.txt' + Copy affordance) and a whitespace-pre-wrap <pre> body in platinum/90; key phrases and the hex codes (#1c1c1e, #c7c7cc) are wrapped in paper-white font-600 spans to read like syntax highlighting.

A white container card with a layered soft shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(28,28,30,.04), 0 30px 60px -34px rgba(28,28,30,.22)) that on hover lifts translateY(-2px) and deepens the shadow; used for the form card.

structured.special_notes: Icons are Iconify Phosphor (ph:*) loaded from the iconify CDN. Tailwind is configured via CDN with custom named colors ink #1c1c1e, ink2 #2c2c2e, platinum #c7c7cc, mist #f4f4f5, paper #fbfbfa. The floating-label and underline-draw effects are 100% CSS (no JS); a .is-focused helper class is only used to freeze the focus state for a static capture and should be dropped in production. Selection color is ink-on-paper. Source pattern: floating-label input on CodePen (https://codepen.io/AdrianBece/pen/KKKZQOY). All accent comes from a single graphite hue plus opacity, never multiple colors.
